name: Defined protagonist
author: PokePat
description: The player character and the rival get fixed names, and the gender is fixed: Professor Rowan's intro skips the questions "Are you a boy or a girl?", "What is your name?" and the naming of the rival. Set the names and the gender below after switching the mod on.

edits.text: manager->state = RI_STATE_LOAD_ROWAN_TILEMAP_0; // PokePat mod platinum-defined-protagonist: no gender and name questions
manager->state = RI_STATE_DELAY_BEFORE_END_0; // PokePat mod platinum-defined-protagonist: no rival naming

usage: Change "Player name", "Rival name" and "Gender" under Settings and build the ROM; start a new game to see it (existing saves keep their names).
